text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship is just around the 
corner! But King-san, who is scheduled to 
run in the same race, is in a slump and 
suffering a string of defeats...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
After the race, despite being exhausted, 
King challenges me to a mock race... The 
result is my overwhelming victory. Even 
so, King refuses to give up and stands 
right back up!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Unyielding tenacity is where her true 
preciousness lies...! Yes, that made me 
realize it. Worrying about her was a 
complete misinterpretation!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She truly is a god... no, a goddess...! In 
the "Mile CS", to avoid shaming her, I 
must face her with everything I've got!
